title: TRON configuration: mapping.falcon.yaml
description: Canonical-instrument-to-broker-symbol mapping table. Ties to falcon.trade_action.v1.instrument / tron.trade_intent.v1.canonical_instrument (input) and tron.trade_intent.v1.broker_instrument (output) — see 05-CONTRACTS.md (WI-B). Contract-owner of this file: WI-D (WO-TRON-D1). This schema defines symbol-resolution structure only; it does not define the fuller broker-profile data model (contract size, tick size, quantity constraints, etc.) described in 08-BROKER-PROFILES.md, which is not schema-backed in this increment.

instrument_name.description: Instrument identifier string, consistent with the length bound used for 'instrument'/'canonical_instrument'/'broker_instrument' in the canonical contracts (05-CONTRACTS.md).

config_schema_version.description: Configuration schema major version for this file. Must equal "1". See 07-CONFIGURATION.md §2 for the evolution policy.

mappings.description: Map keyed by canonical_instrument (as used upstream in falcon.trade_action.v1.instrument) to its broker symbol mapping entry. Using canonical_instrument as the object key structurally guarantees each canonical instrument maps to at most one entry — a duplicate-key situation cannot be represented, so no separate uniqueness check is needed.

broker_instrument.description: The broker-resolved symbol TRON's negotiation stage writes into tron.trade_intent.v1.broker_instrument for this canonical instrument.

enabled.description: Whether this mapping entry is currently active. Absent means true (enabled). Setting false disables negotiation for this canonical instrument without deleting the historical mapping record.
